Rewind was a lightweight, open-source, local-first gaming recorder designed for instant replay, screen recording, and clip editing. It prioritized performance and privacy by avoiding cloud dependencies, accounts, and telemetry, allowing users to capture and manage their gameplay moments locally. Although development has ceased, the project remains available as a public fork.

Contrack is a self-hosted, privacy-focused contact management application designed to consolidate, enrich, and track personal and professional contacts.
